name: Xcode release watcher
tagline: Daily check of Apple's developer feed that flags your Xcode build the moment it ships.
description: Point it at the Xcode version you are waiting for and it checks Apple's developer release feed once a day. When that build appears, you get a clear alert instead of refreshing the page yourself.
author: NatashaTheRobot
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
